source.cells: A Brand AE-VMS List 8200 - Slotting (printed p.1339); row '5/64'; column 'Precipitation Stainless Steel': Speed RPM 11250; Feed in/min 13.5; Cutting Speed header 200-260 SFM; Depth of Cut aa=0.25D, ar=1.0D (full slot, as drawn)

vendor_notes: The above milling condition is a guidline for overhang length 3xD.
Use a rigid and precise machine and holder.
The rotational speed is calculated by the median of the recommended cutting speed. Adjustments may be necessary depending on the rigidity of the workpiece, fixture, and machine.
Please use a suitable fluid with high smoke retardant properties.
During dry (no fluid) milling, please use air blow to remove chips from the milling area and to eliminate chip packing.
Please use water-soluble coolant when machining stainless steel.
Reduce speed and feed as well as depth of cut when high precision is required.
Adjust the speed and feed accordingly when the overhang length is longer than specified (refer to Parameter Reduction Chart).
Parameter Reduction Chart, Slotting: L/D 4 -> 60% speed and feed; L/D 5 -> 50%.
rows.notes: Computed: SFM = 11250 rpm x pi x D / 12 = 230 (D = 0.0781 in); fz = 13.5 in/min / (11250 rpm x 4 flutes) = 0.00030 in/tooth. ap = aa=0.25D -> 0.0195 in; ae = ar=1.0D (full slot, as drawn) -> 0.0781 in. Column 'Precipitation Stainless Steel'; the List 8200 material-suitability chart names 17-4 PH; heat-treat condition not stated. Catalog Type 1 (relieved neck drawn); neck diameter and neck length are not published. Helix is printed as a 37-40 deg range on the list; 38.5 is its midpoint. variable_pitch=true is inferred from the Anti-Vibration series name and the helix range (unequal flute spacing not directly verified from the sheets). Several LOC variants exist for this diameter; the shortest-LOC EDP is used.
